title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1992-03-06
source: flac16/48kHz; DAT soundboard master > Cassette; Cassette > DAT via Nakamichi Dragon to Sony PCM R-500 DAT 48khz; Digital Transfer and FLAC encoding by Jim Wise: October 2014; DAT played back on a Sony PCM R-500-> Digital Audio Labs Carddeluxe-> WAV [16/48]; Adobe Audition 3.0- FLAC encoding; Digital Transfer and FLAC encoding by Jim Wise: October 2014

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard recording of a memorable show – Jerry's final performance at the Mothership and an overall enjoyable night despite some first‑set hiccups.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is praised as sounding great, delivering clear and balanced audio. The concert itself was not bombastic but enjoyable, highlighted by Jerry’s last appearance on that stage and a hometown vibe for Bruce (Bob). Minor “bugs” in the first set were noted but didn’t detract from the overall experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two reviews, one highly positive (4★) praising both performance and soundboard quality; the other offers no substantive feedback. The weighted impression is a solid show with good recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard source praised as sounding great; no specific issues or flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set had a few minor 'bugs' but the overall flow was solid and enjoyable, especially noted for Jerry's last show at the venue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Last show at "the Mothership" mentioned positively.
